hebrew_font.title: Hebrew font
hebrew_font.description: The font the sidebar's Hebrew is drawn in: Frank Ruhl (the default) or Shlomo, both bundled, with nikkud. The Desktop app draws with it directly; for Ghostty it's installed for your user and Ghostty's Hebrew is mapped to it. System leaves every font alone.
